text: Reached 0.2 (billing added) after ~47 s of game-time pushing; stamina bar appeared on the slope at 0.1 -> 0.2 (~90% after the climb).

Refactor (hold F ~10 s) on router merged it into auth: Modules 8->7, banner 'Refactored into auth. One less thing to keep, and what is left is new.' Users unchanged (100), health dipped 95->93, stamina did not visibly drop. A short F tap (2 s) showed a bar at 20% and lost progress on release.

Retire (hold R ~10 s) on search: Users 100->93, Modules 7->6, health 93->91. Weight bar unchanged at 4/10. Stamina bar vanished from HUD (full?). No retire banner visible at the moment I looked (refactor got one).

Parser went DOWN after ~3 game-min left alone: HUD turns red 'OUTAGE: users are leaving' (100->85), storage listed as 'uses parser, down' rotting -45%/min vs -39 before. Clear. But billing's prompt says 'rotting (86%)' while billing is absent from the OPEN ISSUES list - unclear whether it needs attention. Weight bar climbed 4->7 while I stood still.

Patching the cause (parser, DOWN) with E fixed the cascade at once: storage's 'uses parser, down' issue vanished, OUTAGE banner cleared, weight 7->4, health 67->82. Users lost (100->74) did not come back. A first 3 s E hold on the DOWN module showed no progress bar/feedback at all (pp1); a further 4 s hold finished it.

Shipped 0.3 (cache added, users 74->134) after ~36 s of Shift+W from the 0.2 terrace. Stamina bar never appeared during the push (push1-3) and shows 90% only on arrival - tiredness never limited me; the bar's visibility rule is unclear.

Sitting (Q) on the 0.3 terrace: whole HUD hides and a line reads 'The boulder is still. For a moment, so are you.' over the valley view. Beautiful, but with the HUD gone I cannot see stamina refilling or issues rotting, so I cannot judge whether rest is worth it; stamina was already 90%.

Patching core (used by auth, ui, parser...) while it was only drifting did nothing for auth/storage drift - only a module that is DOWN spreads. Fine, but nothing on screen says that 'rotting' (shown in a module's prompt, e.g. ui 75%) differs from an open issue; ui rotted to ~74% without ever appearing in OPEN ISSUES.

Could not reach storage (37%, worst issue) on the 0.3 terrace in ~3 min of trying: from the uphill side W into the boulder no longer rolls it (rb4, rb7: it stays put, presumably at the terrace edge, with no message saying so), and mouse-look plus walking around a 3 m ball with a fixed centre crosshair keeps landing on auth/ui/core. No on-stone marker or HUD hint says where the listed module is.
